description: This file contains API client functions for fetching user analytics data such as tenant user summaries and active user trends from backend endpoints. It includes helper functions for normalizing query parameters and handles error cases gracefully.

methods.name: normalizeQuery(params = {})
methods.description: Helper function to convert query parameters, especially Date objects and strings, into ISO string format and to omit undefined or null values.

methods.name: getTenantUsersSummary(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a summary of tenant users with optional filter parameters. Returns an object with items array and total count. Handles HTTP errors with specific fallback for 404 and 400 status codes.

methods.name: getActiveUsersTrend(params = {})
methods.description: Retrieves the trend of active users over time with optional filters, returning an array of date-count pairs and optional metadata. Handles errors similarly to the previous method.
